name: AI Content Assistant — MCP
description: Exposes AI Content Assistant as MCP tools
project_description: Submodule of AI Content Assistant that exposes content discovery and draft-creation as Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, so external AI clients (Claude Desktop, claude.ai, Claude Code, Codex) can plan and create Drupal draft content directly. It registers five mcp_server Tool plugins — list_content_types, describe_content_type, list_entities, get_node (read-only) and create_node (write, draft-only) — and depends on mcp_server, mcp_server_oauth and the simple_oauth_21 OAuth-discovery submodules for authenticated access. Every tool gates on the 'generate ai content' permission and runs as the OAuth-authenticated Drupal user, so the same per-bundle create permissions and entity-view access apply whether a person works in the Drupal UI or through an AI client. A small event subscriber turns anonymous 403s on the MCP endpoint into RFC 9728 401 Bearer challenges so discovery-less clients can start the OAuth flow.
